articles.title: Houston Astros' Christian Vázquez defies the odds to catch 1,000 MLB games
articles.description: Christian Vázquez jokes about going bald, but his path to 1,000 games caught shows why pitchers and winning teams have trusted him for years.

articles.title: Jorge Barrosa joins Houston Astros. Why they added him despite middling offensive numbers
articles.description: Jorge Barrosa joined the Astros after the Diamondbacks designated him for assignment last week. He could become the 16th different player to appear in Houston's outfield this season.

articles.title: Houston Astros claim outfielder Jorge Barrosa off waivers from Arizona Diamondbacks
articles.description: The Astros have started 11 different left fielders this year as they welcome another new outfielder in Jorge Barrosa.

articles.title: Astros can't lock down lead, miss late opportunities in 10-inning loss to Diamondbacks
articles.description: Houston couldn't hold a two-run lead in the late innings and lost out on an opportunity to pad its AL West lead, falling in extra innings to Arizona.

articles.title: A 'pretty surreal' family reunion for Houston Astros prospect Keon Johnson at Daikin Park
articles.description: Keon Johnson, the 18-year-old infielder who chose the Astros over Vanderbilt, celebrated catching up with family at what he hopes is his future professional home.

articles.title: Houston Astros option Kai-Wei Teng to Triple-A, recall Miguel Ullola
articles.description: The Houston Astros optioned reliever Kai-Wei Teng to Triple-A Sugar Land and recalled reliever Miguel Ullola prior to Sunday’s game against the Arizona Diamondbacks.

articles.title: Nolan Arenado’s 2-run homer lifts the Diamondbacks past the Astros 3-2
articles.description: Nolan Arenado hit a two-run homer to lead the Arizona Diamondbacks to a 3-2 win over the Houston Astros on Sunday. Arizona took two of three games this weekend for its first series win in ...

articles.title: Diamondbacks' Geraldo Perdomo leaves game vs. Astros after being hit on helmet by line drive
articles.description: The Arizona shortstop was down for several minutes after being hit by a teammate's line drive while on the bases.

articles.title: Moreno's go-ahead RBI single in 10th gives D-Backs 4-3 win over Astros
articles.description: Gabriel Moreno hit a tiebreaking RBI single in the 10th inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied for a 4-3 victory over the Houston Astros on Saturday night. Geraldo Perdomo led off the 10th with ...

articles.title: Houston Astros stay hot, shut down Arizona Diamondbacks to take series opener
articles.description: Cristian Javier had his best start in some time and the bullpen locked it down as Houston's early burst of offense held up for its fourth win in five games on the homestand.

articles.title: Houston Astros' bullpen suffers key loss with setup man Steven Okert going on injured list
articles.description: The invaluable setup man will miss at least three series with a hamstring ailment, a big blow to an Astros bullpen that's been a key for the first-place club.
